info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Platform & Hardware
info.description: Platform: hardware modules, stacking, controllers, transceivers, diagnostics, licensing.

get.description:
Retrieve platform configuration from the device via RESTCONF.

Returns the current operational or configuration state of this resource.

put.description:
Create or replace platform configuration on the device.

This replaces the entire resource — any fields not included will be removed.

patch.description:
Partially update platform configuration on the device.

Only the fields included in the request body are modified; other fields remain unchanged.

delete.description:
Remove platform configuration from the device configuration.

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
